name: Static & General Mechanical Equipment — Setting, Alignment & Grouting

work_packages.note: Concrete strength, anchor-bolt template survey, level survey of top-of-concrete before any setting
Offload, inspect for transit damage, rig into position over foundation
Coarse then final level; soft-foot check for machinery
Epoxy or cementitious grout under baseplate/soleplate; interface with civil for grout spec and surface prep
Torque to spec after grout cure; punch and MC

activities: Accept equipment foundation (28-day / spec concrete strength)
Survey anchor-bolt locations and projections against template
Survey and record top-of-concrete level and flatness
Chip/roughen and clean grout-bearing surface
Confirm embedded plates / pockets / sleeves as per GA
sequence.note: No equipment is set until the foundation is surveyed and accepted; template survey prevents baseplate/anchor mismatch

activities: Offload and inspect equipment for transit/preservation damage
Verify tag, nameplate and orientation against GA
Rig and lower equipment/baseplate over anchor bolts
Set on levelling shims, jack bolts or levelling nuts
sequence.note: Setting is coarse; final elevation is established by shim/jackbolt, not by grout

activities: Level baseplate/soleplate to tolerance (typ. 0.05 mm/m)
Check for soft foot on machinery mounts
Set final elevation and hold with jack/levelling screws
Form and dam grout area, prime with epoxy where specified
Place grout (cementitious or epoxy), vent air, cure
Remove/back-off levelling screws after cure; final torque anchor bolts
sequence.note: Grout must fully cure before final anchor torque and before any load or piping is connected

activities: Connect process/utility piping to equipment nozzles
Verify no pipe strain (dial-indicator check at flanges/coupling)
Fit and set spring/rigid pipe supports near equipment
sequence.note: Piping must be cold-sprung/aligned to the nozzle — the equipment is never pulled to meet a mis-fabricated spool

activities: Terminate power to any driver/actuator
Land instrument, control and earthing connections
Bond equipment to the earthing grid
Installation dimensional check vs GA
Grout cure and anchor-torque records verified
Punch-list walkdown, mechanical completion sign-off
sequence.note: MC is the gate to testing

activities: Hydrotest/leak-test connected piping
Function-test any manual/actuated valves and interlocks
Cleaning/flushing of connected systems
Preservation removal, lubrication to running condition
Post-flush final alignment re-check
sequence.note: Final alignment is re-verified AFTER piping is connected and systems flushed — pipe strain and thermal state can move the machine

activities: Energise/operate under process conditions
Performance and acceptance run

typical_relationships.before: Foundation cured and surveyed (level + anchor template)
typical_relationships.reason: Equipment cannot be set until concrete has reached strength and the anchor pattern is confirmed to match the baseplate
Grout locks in the final level and position; it is placed only after the machine is set and levelled
Torquing anchors before grout has cured pulls the baseplate down onto an incompletely supported bed and destroys the level
Connecting piping to an ungrouted, un-torqued machine transfers pipe load into an unsupported baseplate
Connected pipe strain and flushing can shift the machine; alignment must be verified in the as-connected state
Equipment must be bonded to earth before any electrical energisation
A template survey catches anchor mismatch while the machine is still on the truck, not hanging from the crane

interfaces.requirement: Equipment setting REQUIRES the foundation cured to spec strength, anchor bolts/pockets surveyed to template, and top-of-concrete level recorded and accepted
Grouting REQUIRES agreed grout type/spec and a prepared, roughened, clean bearing surface
Nozzle connection REQUIRES connecting spools fabricated and erected to the nozzle position with acceptable flange alignment (no strain)
Energisation REQUIRES the equipment bonded to the earthing grid
Driver/actuator operation REQUIRES permanent (or commissioning) power terminated and available
Equipment on a steel plinth/mezzanine REQUIRES the supporting steel erected, aligned and grouted/bolted before setting

testing_requirements: Foundation level and anchor-template survey records
Baseplate/soleplate final level within tolerance (e.g. 0.05 mm/m)
Soft-foot check for any machined-mount equipment
Grout cure certificate / compressive-strength confirmation before final torque
Anchor-bolt torque record to specified value
Flange alignment / pipe-strain (dial-indicator) record at nozzles
commissioning_dependencies: Grout fully cured and anchors torqued
Connected piping tested, flushed and cleared
Final alignment re-verified in as-connected state
Permanent or temporary commissioning power available
typical_exceptions: Spring-mounted / anti-vibration-mounted equipment is levelled on its mounts, not grouted
Small skid-mounted units may arrive pre-grouted on their own baseplate and only need anchoring
Free-standing light equipment may be bolted to inserts without grout
evidence: Equipment was set and piping connected before the baseplate grout had cured and anchors were finally torqued, leaving the machine loaded on an unsupported baseplate.
